incomeRankGuide.title: How XP and Rank work
incomeRankGuide.subtitle: Every mission you complete becomes long-term progress and moves you toward a higher Rank
incomeRankGuide.overviewTitle: First: Rank and Skill Level are different
incomeRankGuide.rankConceptDescription: Measures your overall income-building experience using XP from every mission. Higher-impact missions help you grow faster.
incomeRankGuide.skillConceptDescription: Measures each skill separately using completed work, so every skill progresses independently in your Skill Map.

xpRules.description: Mark a mission complete on the Earn page and its XP will be recorded automatically.

xpRules.title: Higher-impact missions earn more
xpRules.description: Actions closer to real income, such as closing a client or asking for a referral, award more XP than preparation tasks.

xpRules.title: Each mission awards XP once
xpRules.description: Undoing and completing the same mission again will not add more XP, so Rank reflects genuine progress.

incomeRankGuide.missionXpDescription: This table reads directly from the rules currently used by the system.
incomeRankGuide.rankRoadmapDescription: XP from every mission is combined to unlock your next Rank.
incomeRankGuide.protectionDescription: XP and Rank are a permanent record of progress. Once earned, XP is not removed even if you undo a mission later.
incomeRankGuide.tipDescription: Choose missions that create real outcomes, keep goals realistic for your available time, and build consistency instead of duplicating missions for points.

help.title: How to use WEALTH OS
help.subtitle: Know your money, grow your income, build your wealth — an easy guide to every feature in the app.
help.lastUpdated: Last updated Sep 30, 2026 · updated every time a new feature ships

steps.title: Add your first account
steps.description: Go to the "Money" tab and add an account you actually have — cash, bank, or credit card. Set the starting balance to match reality.

steps.title: Log your income and expenses
steps.description: Every time money comes in or goes out, tap "+" to log it. The app updates your balances and net worth automatically.

steps.title: Set your first goal
steps.description: Go to the "Plan" tab and set a savings or emergency fund goal. The app will start telling you what to do next on the home page.

items.title: Minimize a form while filling it in
items.description: Filling in a transaction, goal, asset, etc. and need to check something on another page first? Tap the "−" button in the form's top-right corner to shrink it into a floating button — go anywhere in the app and nothing you typed is lost. Tap the floating button to pick up right where you left off.

items.title: Pull down to refresh
items.description: At the top of a page, pull down to refresh with the latest data — same gesture as most apps.

story.title: Prefer a story to a list? Try this

sections.title: Home
sections.description: Your whole financial picture in one place — open the app and immediately know where you stand and what to do next.

items.title: Net Worth
items.description: The biggest number on the home page, with a 6-month trend chart.

items.title: Wealth Score
items.description: An overall financial health score from 0-100, based on cash flow, savings, debt, and goals.

items.title: Safe-to-Spend
items.description: How much you can spend today without hurting your budget or goals.

items.title: Next Best Action
items.description: The single top recommendation the system picked for you specifically.

items.title: Recent Transactions
items.description: Your latest transactions with each account's balance — tap to view or edit.

sections.title: Money
sections.description: Where every baht gets logged and tracked — from daily income and expenses to every asset and liability you own.

items.title: Quick capture (center + button)
items.description: Type something short like "lunch 80 cash" or "Grab 145". Amount, category and account are filled in for you, then tap ✓ to save. You can also speak, or scan a slip/receipt (always confirmed by you, never saved automatically). Need every field? Tap "Manual entry".

items.title: Today's inbox
items.description: Today's quick captures and anything with a guessed category appear in a card on Home. Tap ✓ to confirm or tap the category to fix it; the app remembers that merchant next time.

items.title: Transactions
items.description: Log income, expenses, or transfers between accounts. Search, filter, and revisit notes you've saved.

items.title: Accounts
items.description: Manage cash, bank, and credit card accounts — see each balance and the total.

items.title: Budget
items.description: Set a budget per category and track whether you're over or under.

items.title: Assets / Liabilities
items.description: Log what you own and owe, so Net Worth is calculated completely.

items.title: Net Worth
items.description: Assets minus liabilities, with a breakdown of what's included.

items.title: Recurring
items.description: Set up transactions that repeat monthly, plus reminders for upcoming bills.

items.title: Subscription Detector
items.description: Automatically scans for recurring subscriptions you might have forgotten to cancel.

sections.title: Plan
sections.description: From knowing where you stand today to planning ahead — set goals, build a safety net, and simulate your financial future.

items.title: Goals
items.description: Set savings goals and track progress visually.

items.title: Emergency Fund
items.description: Set a safety-net target — the app suggests a number of months of essential expenses.

items.title: Money Year
items.description: Plan a full year, broken into quarters and months, against income, savings, and investment targets — then compare to actuals.

items.title: Debt Planner
items.description: Simulate paying off debt with the Snowball or Avalanche method and see which clears debt faster.

items.title: Forecast
items.description: Simulate "what if" scenarios to see the future impact of a decision before you make it.

sections.title: Earn
sections.description: What sets WEALTH OS apart from a typical finance app — it doesn't just help you save, it helps you earn more too.

items.title: Your starting point
items.description: Answer 8 short questions (about 3 minutes), one at a time. You'll see what to focus on now — e.g. first income or stability. Leave and resume any time; reassess whenever you like, past results are kept.

items.title: What should I do today?
items.description: The green card on Earn shows the one next thing to do, with a time estimate. When you finish, the next step is recalculated.

items.title: Income paths
items.description: Four kinds: Career, Freelance/Service, Business/Product and Investment (planning only — never buy/sell advice). Have several at once. Each path has a step-by-step plan showing where you are and what's next.

items.title: Suggested experiments
items.description: Start small — low cost, fast feedback, e.g. make one sample and show it to 5 customers. Each suggestion says why it fits you; no percentage scores.

items.title: Missions and results
items.description: Missions are real actions. Record what happened (how many you contacted, how many replied), then continue, adjust and retry, pause or switch paths. A weak result is still useful information.

items.title: Record real income
items.description: Got paid from a path? Tap “Record real income”: the money goes into your real account like any income, balances and net worth update immediately, a repeated tap never double-records, and you can link a project (optional).

items.title: My Skills
items.description: Skills grow from real evidence: learning, action and outcomes. Link skills to paths and mission results count as evidence automatically. XP and Rank are just motivation.

items.title: Opportunities
items.description: Curated side-income ideas, each explaining what it is, why it might be worth trying and a small first experiment. Tap “Start as a path” to begin. Income figures are rough ranges, never guaranteed.

items.title: Income Profile
items.description: Log every income source and compare your average monthly income with your target.

sections.title: AI Money Coach
sections.description: A financial assistant you can talk to about anything — it only ever answers from your real data, never guesses.

items.title: Ask anything about money
items.description: Like "did I overspend this month?" — the AI pulls your real data to answer.

items.title: Floating AI button on every page
items.description: Tap the floating AI button (drag it anywhere) to open the assistant over the current page — Chat · Summary · Analyze · Tools tabs, one-tap starter cards, and voice input where your browser supports it. Tap the button again to close.

items.title: Adjust the AI button's opacity
items.description: Settings → Floating AI button → Idle opacity (15–100%, default 40%). The button fades after 3 seconds untouched, like iPhone's AssistiveTouch. You can also hide the button with the "Show floating AI button" switch on the same card.

items.title: Attach a photo
items.description: Attach a screenshot or photo — like a form field you don't understand — and the AI can explain it (never saved, used only for that one reply).

items.title: Daily insights
items.description: Short, useful observations about your financial habits.

items.title: Monthly message limit
items.description: Free: 15 · Plus: 150 · Pro: 500 messages per month.

sections.title: Missions & Wealth XP
sections.description: Makes staying consistent with your money a little more fun — no pressure, and a missed streak is always easy to restart.

items.title: Wealth Missions
items.description: Small activities that improve your financial health, completed automatically as you use the app normally.

items.title: Levels & XP
items.description: Points earned from completing missions — a motivational nudge, not a real financial metric.

items.title: Streaks
items.description: Weekly check-ins and monthly reviews. The app never scolds a missed streak, just invites you back.

glossary.definition: Everything you own, minus everything you owe.
A 0-100 financial health score from 7 factors, calculated the same way every time — never an AI guess.
What you can spend right now without hurting your budget or goals.
Money set aside for the unexpected — typically 3-6 months of essential expenses.
Target income minus current income — used to pick which missions and opportunities to suggest.
A full-year plan split into quarters and months, compared against actuals. Past years are never overwritten.

help.disclaimer: WEALTH OS never promises you'll get rich. It's a tool to help you see your finances clearly and make better decisions — not investment advice.
